name: Cash Runway Forecast
summary: Projects monthly burn and runway under base, lean and growth scenarios from numbers you provide.
description: Calculations are deterministic code, not model output: the model only helps structure your assumptions and explain the result. Produces a month-by-month table and the date cash falls below your safety threshold in each scenario.
problems: I don't know how many months of runway I have
I need to plan hiring against cash

inputs.label: Cash on hand
inputs.description: Current bank balance in your reporting currency.

inputs.label: Growth assumptions
inputs.description: Expected revenue growth and planned hires.

outputs.label: Summary
outputs.description: Runway per scenario and the main drivers.

steps.name: Structure assumptions
steps.responsibility: Turn free-text assumptions into explicit numeric scenario parameters.

steps.name: Calculate
steps.responsibility: Compute the forecast deterministically from the parameters.

steps.name: Explain
steps.responsibility: Summarize the result without changing any number.

criteria.description: Numbers in the summary match the calculated table.
